name: 双拼色块原切牛腱肉款
description: 柠黄珊瑚双拼色块展台，厚切原块切面微距，家常炖香场景与留空凭证收口

styleLock.direction: bright cold-chain pop-market fresh meat commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: hard-edged two-block pop field: a lemon plane #F4DE73 meeting a coral wedge #F5A5A2 on one straight diagonal, no gradient and no scenery; information screens switch to a flat cream card wall #FCF3E1; the closing screen runs on a frost floor #E4EAEA with a pine-green liner #245248
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool daylight-balanced 5600K studio grade, broad key from the upper left with a large fill card, short grounded contact shadows, one controlled specular on cut faces, no rim light, no spotlight falloff, no candlelit warmth
styleLock.surfaceSystem: crushed-ice chill bed #DCE4E6 inside a deep pine-green glazed oval dish #245248, or a smooth cream card plane #FCF3E1 laid flat; never a wood board, never a woven cloth
styleLock.typography: one wide modern geometric sans-serif, display lines in charcoal #3A342E and label lines in the same family at a lighter weight; every in-image line stays a placeholder slot rather than reproduced source copy
styleLock.iconSystem: flat single-weight line icons in #C9462F plus solid disc labels in #F5A5A2; no shaded 3D icons, no foil borders, no photographic badge artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: the subject is always one firm whole raw cut or a single loose layer of cuts on the pine-green dish or in the ice bed, dish turned the same quarter to frame at the same scale; cooked serving styling appears only in the two serving-idea screens; nothing cropped by the frame edge
noDrift: no amber or candlelit food grade on any screen, the whole set holds the cool daylight 5600K grade
no dark charcoal or black studio field, no ribbed slate plinth and no dramatic spotlight falloff
no wood board, no linen or cloth weave, no rice paper and no rustic market-stall surface
no fifth hue beyond lemon, coral, cream and pine green, no gold keylines and no foil seal borders
no legible brand marks, QR codes, membership pills, coupon corners or store and platform wording
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright cold-chain pop-market fresh meat visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a lemon plane #F4DE73 meeting a coral wedge #F5A5A2 in one hard-edged diagonal two-block field, a flat cream card wall #FCF3E1 for information screens, and a deep pine-green glazed serving dish #245248 as the only dark anchor; cool daylight-balanced 5600K grade, never amber or candlelit; one wide modern geometric sans-serif in charcoal #3A342E with vermilion line icons #C9462F and solid coral disc labels #F5A5A2; flat matte colour-block planes plus a crushed-ice chill bed #DCE4E6, no gradient, no wood board, no linen or woven cloth; broad key from the upper left with a large fill card, short grounded contact shadows and one controlled specular on cut faces; the subject always presented as firm whole raw cuts on the pine-green dish or in the ice bed, cooked styling only in the serving-idea screens; generous copy margin held on the upper left of every screen; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no warm amber food grade, no dark charcoal studio field, no stock-photo garnish clutter, no invented numbers.
